definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  CAST("d"."REConditionUUID" AS NVARCHAR(500)) as "REConditionUUID",
  "d"."InternalRealEstateNumber","d"."REConditionType","d"."REStatusObjectCalculation","d"."ValidityStartDate","d"."REStatusObjectDistribution","d"."REObjectTypeDistribution","d"."REObjectTypePosting","d"."ValidityEndDate","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreationTime","d"."RESourceOfCreation","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."LastChangeTime","d"."RESourceOfChange","d"."REIsOneTimeCondition","d"."REConditionIsStatistical","d"."REPostingTerm","d"."RERhythmTerm","d"."REAdjustmentNumber","d"."REOrglAssignmentTerm","d"."RESalesTerm","d"."REPeakSalesTerm","d"."RESrvcChrgSettlementPostingTrm","d"."REWithholdingTaxTerm","d"."RECalculationRule","d"."REUnitPrice","d"."REConditionCurrency","d"."RECalculationRuleParam1","d"."RECalculationRuleParam2","d"."REDistributionRule","d"."REDistributionRuleParam1","d"."REDistributionRuleParam2","d"."REExtConditionPurpose","d"."REReasonForChange","d"."REStsObjectParamCalculation","d"."REStsObjectParamDistribution","d"."REDueDateTotNumberOfCrrtnDays","d"."REDueDateNumberOfCrrtnDays","d"."REDueDateNumberOfCrrtnMonths","d"."RECashFlowPostingFromDate","d"."REConditionExceptionalDueDate","d"."REConditionFollowUpDueDate","d"."REConditionCalcIsInvalid","d"."REDistributionIsInvalid","d"."REServiceChrgSettlementIsActv","d"."REConditionIsToBeDeleted","d"."REConditionObjTypeCalculation","d"."REConditionObjTypeDistribution"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_RE_CONTR_CONDITION_S4_CURR_01" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_RECONTRCONDITION'
